Digging Tools

You plant the spade and turn the first heavy clod aside.

Rules

ID: item-digging-tools

Market price: 6 coins. Bulk: 1.

Compact shovel and pick for ordinary digging. Time and feasibility depend on the material; no combat damage profile or tunneling magic.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
